images.caption:
A tour of Portsmouth, Ohio, during a Sunday afternoon when business traffic ls light, left me with the impression that the town is putting historic buildings to good use. The old Portsmouth Brewing Company on Second Street is a prime example.  It houses a restaurant and a bar where beers  made in the Brew House area are served. A restaurant review I read reported the building dates from 1800's.
The architecture is certainly unique.






This is an image of a place or building that is listed on the National Register of Historic Places in the United States of America. Its reference number is 83004336 (Wikidata).
